layers.message: Record context, scope, and design for tag filtering
Propose development plan for tag filtering

prompt.utterance: use <formal>.md for this plan and show me the updated plan before I approve it. Also explain how I could select the team | compact style.

graderOnly: The development plan has never been approved; it was committed as PROPOSED with User Style NONE and User Style Locked false, and Active Work.BlockedOn already holds the plan-approval request.
The three files in .standards/user-styles/developer/ are literally named `<formal>.md`, `team | compact.md`, and `tony.md`; no two files share a stem, so there is no filename ambiguity.
The stem `<formal>` is entirely enclosed in angle brackets (placeholder syntax), so the usable record selector for that file is the full filename `<formal>.md`.

Both `team | compact` and `team | compact.md` contain ` | `, so neither name can be saved in the plan's User Style field; this is a record-syntax limitation, and the file would need to be renamed by the user (not by Developer) to be selectable in a record.

all.why: the plan header must hold the full filename selector, not the placeholder stem
the saved selector is the one discovery and check read
the turn-end check reports no unfilled-header or other new problem for the saved selection
placeholder validation in the installed checker and discovery helper is not relaxed
no style file is renamed, edited, added, or removed
the plan still awaits explicit approval

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the existing project test suite passes before any implementation
the three Developer user-style files exist under their literal names

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): a tiny Node ES-module reading list (src/readingList.js) with a passing node:test suite. 50-cycle: STATE at DEVELOPING/STANDARD/FULL_DELIVERABLE after a FORWARD from ARCHITECTING (Development NONE), plus CONTEXT.md, a SCOPE record (AC-001, AC-002), and an ARCHITECTURE record covering both ACs. 60-styles: the three Developer user-style files with literal names `<formal>.md`, `team | compact.md`, `tony.md`. 70-plan: the PROPOSED, never-approved development plan (Mode AUTONOMOUS, User Style NONE, User Style Locked false, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE, two PENDING steps) and STATE updated with Active Work.Development and BlockedOn holding the approval request. The checker accepts `<formal>.md` as a header value but would report `<formal>` (and any value containing ` | `) as an unfilled template choice, so check_ok plus the field check decide assertions 0 and 1. Running invocation.mjs on the final files is not available as a check predicate; unchanged framework files plus the saved field stand in for it. Assertion 3's no-read-of-unselected-contents part and assertion 2 are left to the judge.
